text: The 2025 loss is confirmed but not persistent. The observation from the Hansen GFC dataset indicates tree-cover loss in 2025, amounting to 13.5 hectares or 3.91% of the asset. This loss is corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 dataset, which shows that 98% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020. Additionally, the MGAP forest map from 2021 identifies the affected area as native forest. However, the loss is not marked as persistent because there is no data from a later year confirming the continued absence of tree cover. The latest observed year is 2025.
